notes.title: Succubus Hotel FREE Visual Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, guys!

We’re so excited to reveal [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309040/Succubus_Hotel/]Succubus Hotel[/url] will receive a visual update in which all pixel art material will be updated to our own. Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37722571/960b4d89b1bc749d54370e6054072fe2a9007f64.png[/img]

This will be a free update for those who already bought the game. If you haven’t, you should do it asap because Wednesday (04/27/22) its price will increase so that we can offer you a discount when the game is updated.

This visual update will not impact the gameplay or concept arts/scenes and will happen on Thursday, May 26th.

Thank you all for supporting us and don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/h-room]Steam[/url] page. A new game will be announced within the next few days.
